description: A bridge database on the field observations during the 2023 Kahramanmaras, Turkey Earthquakes (Mw=7.8, Mw=7.6) is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Selcuk Bas, Bartin University. This project presents detailed information about the status of bridges inspected after The 2023 Kahramanmaras, Turkiye Earthquakes. The data in this project can be considered for statistical analysis and comparative studies. Post-earthquake bridge damage observations are compiled from the 140 bridges visited by the project members. Coverage: Kahramanmaras Province. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: Kahramanmaras Earthquakes, Bridge database, earthquake reconnaissance. Published 2024-06-20. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
